hold_text: Wake planner: a posted ltr-wake marker entry whose evidence_state/packet_state is could_not_commit / could_not_build / evidence_conflict no longer counts as already posted (nor starts the per-package cooldown) once it is 10 minutes old, so the next poster pass rebuilds it and wakes a reviewer. why: Stop a failed packet commit from silently dropping a live review.
